title: Data Stories
subtitle: Visualizations and narratives from public datasets
author: Sunil Dhaka

stories.title: The Rupee Tax: 64 Years of Purchasing Power Destruction
stories.description: Prices multiplied 90x since 1960. But inflation is radically non-uniform -- gold inflated 47x, cars only 3x, and telecom deflated to zero. The average inflation number is a fiction.

stories.title: India's Petroleum Appetite: 239 Million Tonnes and Climbing
stories.description: The world's third-largest oil consumer uses 1/22nd the oil per person that America does. Kerosene has collapsed 93%, India has overtaken China as the #1 source of oil demand growth, and 88% of crude is imported.

stories.title: India's Urban Growth Ponzi Scheme
stories.description: India is importing America's failed suburban development model while abandoning its own traditional cities -- which already embody everything the world's best urbanists now advocate.

stories.title: The Guar Story: Rajasthan's Desert Gold
stories.description: How a drought-resistant bean from the Thar Desert connects Rajasthan's farmers to America's oil rigs -- a $2.5B commodity that's cheapest where it's grown.
